exposure: mode of delivery (normal vaginal delivery vs. cesarean section)
cohort: A total of 203 postpartum women from five health centers in Sanandaj, Iran, were conveniently selected to enroll in this study.
finding: Women who had a cesarean section were less satisfied with their body image than those who had a normal vaginal delivery, but the two groups did not differ significantly in terms of their sexual function.
mod_finding: Women who had a cesarean section were less satisfied with their body image than those who had a normal vaginal delivery, but the two groups did not differ significantly in terms of their sexual function.
